Customer stories

Read detailed stories →
Andrea Malouf Founder of Paradisefold We are a fashion and lifestyle brand creating tools that help women rest, reenergise and optimise time spent on haircare and beauty. We use Getsitecontrol to capture leads and display notifications – such as how far a customer might be from getting free delivery. Getsitecontrol is a tool that’s very intuitive and easy to use — setting popups is really straightforward.
William Burgess CMO of MonsieurChalets We’re a company managing luxury cottage rentals. We started using Getsitecontrol to collect email addresses, and we had a really good conversion rate. In a day, we collected 256 emails! On another campaign, we collected 10,286 emails with a click-through rate of 4.6%. It’s a great tool, we love it here.
Fernando Zarauz KM and Communications We use Getsitecontrol to display surveys, sign-up forms, and announcements on our website. It was super easy to plug in and it was our fastest and most cost-effective route to improve our users’ journey, which was our main goal with it. It has helped us boost sign-ups and gave us more insights into the users’ interaction with our website. Getsitecontrol has all the features we need and it’s always been smooth sailing with it. It’s a no brainer.
Thomas Oppong Founder of AllTopStartups Our goal at AllTopStartups is to help aspiring entrepreneurs get their own business started. I use Getsitecontrol to capture contacts on my website in exchange for a free ebook. I’ve been using it for a while now and I haven’t even looked into other options because it works well for me. Onboarding is quick and the interface is clean and intuitive. Setting up a popup is so easy I had mine up and running in a few minutes.
Andrew Steward Head of Digital Transformation at Explore Explore is a company offering tours in different countries around the world. We’ve been using Getsitecontrol for about five years to capture leads, promote deals, display notifications, and redirect visitors to the right website based on their location. It’s easy to build popups and use templates, we can turn things around quite quickly without involving a developer. Flexibility, speed, cost-effectiveness, Getsitecontrol ticks all those boxes for us.
Rob Fielding Digital Growth Manager at Ethex Ethex is a non-profit ethical investment platform in the UK. It allows people to invest in environmentally-friendly projects. We use Getsitecontrol to display email forms on two of our websites so that our visitors can sign up to be notified about new investment opportunities. One of the reasons why I like it – it does the job. If I need to show a message on a certain page, to new users in a particular location, I can do it pretty easily. Plus, there’s a built-in CSS editor and a pre-designed template gallery, and I find these features really useful.
Ruud Caris Founder at Nozie We’re a Dutch publishing company with a portfolio of niche websites in technology and lifestyle. We use Getsitecontrol on two of our websites to collect subscribers with a lead magnet. I specifically wanted a 2-step form which not a lot of other tools do in the right way. With Getsitecontrol, I could do it.
Derry Content manager at Vagabond Tours Vagabond Tours is a small-group tour operator. We’ve been using Getsitecontrol to capture leads on our website for two years. We were relying on embedded forms before, and we were probably losing a lot of leads. In fact, our lead count jumped quickly after we implemented Getsitecontrol. Their support is really responsive and knowledgeable, our issues always get resolved. I’m generally impressed by the whole tool!
Niels DB Digital Marketing Manager We have been using Getsitecontrol for four years on our four websites. We use Getsitecontrol popups to capture leads and the built-in follow-up automations to send an automated message to our subscribers right after they sign up. The platform has helped us increase our conversions, which was our main goal. One of the strengths of Getsitecontrol is the excellent tech support offered via the chat tool, always helpful and quick.
Thomas Bandini Founder at Thomasbandini I own a digital marketing agency and I work in advertising on Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. Since I discovered Getsitecontrol two years ago, I have been using it on my clients’ websites to capture leads, display notifications and alerts, and display WhatsApp contact buttons. It’s easy to install on any website, intuitive, cost-effective, and gets regular updates and improvements, like the possibility to set up follow-up automations. I’m a big fan.

Common questions
How many sites can I add? You can add several sites in the Billing section of your account. Keep in mind that our prices are per site. All sites in an account will have the same billing plan, e.g. Pro (5 sites) plan.
How are widget views counted? A unique widget view occurs each time a widget is displayed. The total number of views will vary based on how many visitors your website receives monthly. To help you keep things under control, we provide real-time statistics on widget performance, so you can adjust display settings if needed.
What if I reach the view limit? When the number of views reaches the monthly limit allowed on your plan, widgets will stop displaying on your website. All the data will be accessible in your account, and widgets will resume displaying with the beginning of a new monthly cycle.
Are emails included in the subscription plans? Emails are purchased separately. Paid plans offer lower email prices, with extra discounts for larger volumes.
Do you offer any other discounts? Yes, we offer additional discounts. When you choose our annual subscription plan, you can save up to 25%. We also provide dynamic discounts on email purchases – the exact discount depends on your plan and the number of emails you buy.
How many widgets can I create? As many as you wish. There are no limitations on the number of widgets you can create and publish on your website. That includes multiple widgets of the same type, i.e. several email subscription forms, various announcement popups, and so on.
Can I cancel my subscription? Absolutely. There is no commitment, so if you change your mind, you can cancel your subscription anytime. If you need to change your current plan, you can do that too. Add extra sites, switch between plans or monthly and annual billing – any unused balance will be carried over to future billing periods.
Can I install the app for my clients? Of course. Feel free to use Getsitecontrol on the websites you are building or managing for your clients. You can easily manage multiple websites under one account.

Choose your integration
These workflows use the REST API from your backend or scheduler. For an interactive investigation, you can also connect an AI assistant through MCP .
Send new leads to your CRM
Section titled “Send new leads to your CRM”
Use event subscriptions to forward response.created or contact.created events to your receiver. This lets you connect a CRM or email platform even when Getsitecontrol has no native integration for it.
Check the available payloads with List event types .
Create a subscription with your destination URL, headers, and body template.
Test the subscription and inspect its delivery records before relying on it.
Make your receiver tolerate repeated deliveries. A receiving service may require its own authentication and field mapping.
Add contacts from your backend
Section titled “Add contacts from your backend”
When someone signs up in your app, create or update the contact by email ; the response is the contact. To sync a list from another system, create or update contacts in batches of up to 100; the response reports each item. Send the fields your workflow needs, keyed by field ID, and tags by name.
A new contact is subscribed unless you send status: unsubscribed , and a subscribed new contact starts your “new contact” automations. Only subscribe contacts who have given the necessary consent. For an existing contact, leave status out to keep what the contact chose, or send it to keep an unsubscribe in sync.
To start an email workflow for a contact, use Run an automation for a contact . It runs only automations with the automation_start trigger that are on; automations triggered by a new contact start on their own.
Use an idempotency key for POST requests that your integration may retry.
Build a daily popup report
Section titled “Build a daily popup report”
Pull widget performance into a spreadsheet or your own dashboard:
List your sites and choose a site ID.
Retrieve statistics per widget to compare popups.
Retrieve the statistics timeline for daily trends.
Write the results to your reporting destination using its API.
Set the reporting period explicitly and read the endpoint’s metric definitions before combining results. A rate is null , not zero, when a widget had no shows, and without widget_ids the per-widget list leaves out widgets without events. Connecting the destination and scheduling the job are part of your integration.
Audit your popup settings
Section titled “Audit your popup settings”
List widgets and read their settings to build a registry of popups, statuses, and targeting rules. Your script can filter that registry, for example to find widgets shown on a particular URL.
Follow pagination to include every widget, especially on sites with large popup libraries. Targeting comes whole in the list. Check targeting.is_complete : when it is false , some rules could not be read, and warnings says which. Other nested lists and texts can be shortened; truncated names them, and Get a widget returns them whole.
Export form responses
Section titled “Export form responses”
Retrieve responses across widgets or responses from one widget . The response data includes submitted values and visitor context such as UTM parameters, where available.
Follow the returned cursors to collect all pages, then write the records to your own CSV, database, or daily digest. The API returns JSON; your integration produces the file or email. Responses awaiting double opt-in or email checks can appear later with their original IDs and timestamps, so a cursor or created_since alone can miss them. For an incremental export, re-read a time window with a margin and merge records by id .
Investigate a failed sync
Section titled “Investigate a failed sync”
If a contact did not reach a connected service, start with List integration deliveries . Inspect an individual delivery record for details about the failure.
Use these records to identify an authentication, field-mapping, or destination error. The API reads integrations but does not change them: reconnect a native integration or fix its mapping in the Getsitecontrol dashboard.
Use the browser JavaScript API
Section titled “Use the browser JavaScript API”
To control widget display or pass visitor context on your website, use the JavaScript API . Those browser actions are separate from the server-side workflows above.

About Getsitecontrol
About us
At Getsitecontrol, we are passionate supporters of small and medium-sized ecommerce brands. Our mission is to help brand owners grow and generate more sales via onsite campaigns and email marketing — without having to invest a lot in technical implementation. That’s why we’ve designed our products to be intuitive and require no coding or design skills.
Getsitecontrol
Getsitecontrol is an email marketing platform tailored for ecommerce brands. It helps merchants grow and manage their email lists, build automated workflows, and send beautifully designed newsletters.
Beyond email, Getsitecontrol helps you run on-site campaigns using customizable popups and forms: to promote special offers, recover abandoned carts, and gather customer feedback.
Getsitecontrol has an official Shopify app and a WordPress plugin . It also works seamlessly on Squarespace, Bigcommerce, Magento, and other website platforms.
Aurora theme
Aurora is a versatile Shopify theme for small and high-volume store owners. It offers a wide range of customizable blocks and sections, allowing merchants to craft a distinctive and unique style for their stores. Aurora comes equipped with an array of marketing tools to enhance conversions without the need for additional third-party apps.
Shopify apps
Getsitecontrol develops Shopify apps that help merchants improve conversions and drive more sales. The lineup includes GSC Email Marketing & Pop Ups, GSC Countdown Timer Bar, GSC Instagram Feed, and GSC External Links & Buttons. You can explore all apps on Getsitecontrol’s official page in the Shopify App Store .
